pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel-level edge gradients and predominantly angular vertices. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger units on the mid-flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented units on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes are mostly tri-way (Y-intersections). Pathway width remains relatively uniform with minor narrowing at high-curvature corners.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck, exhibiting a dense, brush-like pixel texture against the background.
